blocks.text: You can manage eSIMs provisioned for your organization in the Zscaler Admin Console. After provisioning, the eSIMs are listed on the SIMs page. You can view the SIM details and assign or activate it.
This feature is in limited availability. To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.
After eSIMs are provisioned to your organization, you need to assign them to users.
To assign an eSIM to a user:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Cellular > SIMs.
Locate the eSIM you want to assign to a user and click the link in the ICCID column.
On the SIM Details page, go to the eSIM Info widget and do the following:
Assign Recipient: Enter the name or email address of the user to whom you want to assign the eSIM.
The eSIM is recorded as assigned to the specified user. You can activate or modify the assignment, if required.

blocks.text: If you want to modify the assigned user, click Reassign, enter the name or email address of the new user, and click Update. The eSIM installed on the previous user's device must be manually uninstalled before reassigning it to the new user. To learn more about uninstalling eSIMs, refer to the official user manual for the device.
After assigning an eSIM to a user, you must activate the eSIM.

blocks.item: Locate the eSIM that you want to activate and click the link in the ICCID column.
On the SIM Details page, go to the eSIM Info widget and click View QR Details.
In the SIM QR Info window, scan the QR code from the device that needs the eSIM to be activated. Alternatively, copy the activation code and enter it manually into the device.
For detailed steps on how to scan the QR code or enter the activation code manually on the device, refer to the official device manual.
